units.source_text: 海风把帐子吹得鼓胀起来。

en.t: The sea wind blew the mosquito net until it swelled out.

units.source_text: 帐子过滤着风，无可奈何地飘动着。

en.t: The net filtered the wind and fluttered helplessly.

units.source_text: 所以被风刮成堆的帐子的形状，并不是风的忠实的形状，

en.t: So the shape of the net piled up by the wind was not a faithful shape of the wind itself,

units.source_text: 随着风势渐弱，棱角也消失了。

en.t: and as the force of the wind gradually weakened, its sharp angles also disappeared.

units.source_text: 帐子下角摩擦着铺席，发出了像矮竹叶摇曳似的声音。

en.t: The lower corners of the net rubbed against the matting, making a sound like low bamboo leaves swaying.

units.source_text: 然而传到帐子的不是风吹的动，

en.t: Yet what reached the net was not the movement of being blown by the wind,

units.source_text: 是比风吹时更轻微的动，

en.t: but a movement even fainter than when the wind blew,

units.source_text: 是泛起涟漪似地扩展到整床帐子的动。

en.t: a movement that spread across the whole net like ripples rising on water.
This movement made the coarse cloth net convulse,

units.source_text: 从内侧看见的巨大的帐子的一面，仿佛洋溢着不安的湖面。

en.t: and the vast side of the net seen from within seemed like the surface of a lake brimming with unease.

units.source_text: 不知是湖上远方的船激起的浪头，

en.t: One could not tell whether it was the crest of a wave stirred up by a distant boat on the lake,

units.source_text: 还是已远去的船留下的余波的反映……

en.t: or the reflection of the wake left behind by a boat that had already gone far away...
